plan: My goal is to maximize long-term profit. Since this is the first and only round, I need to maximize profit for *this* round. The optimal strategy in a second-price auction with private values is to bid my true value. This ensures I win when my value is higher than others and pay no more than the second-highest bid. Bidding below my value risks losing a profitable opportunity, while bidding above my value risks winning at a price higher than my value.

Since I pay the second-highest bid, bidding slightly above what I perceive others might bid, but not excessively high, is a good strategy. I will bid a bit below my value to ensure profit if I win.
